projects.name: ArenaBench
projects.description: An adversarial benchmark where LLM agents compete inside a disposable Linux VM. Traces capture system exploration, privilege escalation, and emergent multi-agent behavior.

projects.name: Pokeweb
projects.description: Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum in the browser: recompiled WASM cores in Web Workers, a React interface, local saves, and optional cloud saves.

projects.name: gen4recomp / nativeplat
projects.description: Native Pokémon ports built from decompilations and static recompilation, with a desktop launcher, save tools, display effects, rewind, and multiplayer features. Coverage varies by game.

projects.name: Sokaris
projects.description: A Julia toolkit for programmatic photo editing: composable image operations, editing macros, and an automatically refreshing image viewer.

projects.name: Flytrain / Fruit Fly Heaven
projects.description: A browser neuromechanics experiment connecting the BANC fruit fly connectome to FlyBody in MuJoCo. Flytrain coordinates shared parameter search; autonomous behavior remains an open research goal.

projects.name: npx morisoba
projects.description: A Rust terminal portfolio with ASCII imagery and keyboard navigation, distributed through npm. The same application also runs in the browser through WebAssembly.

projects.name: Eigenfish / eigenself
projects.description: Name-seeded eigenvalue projections: an interactive generator that turns a name into a family of mathematical images.

projects.name: love-canvas
projects.description: An experimental Canvas 2D backend for a subset of LÖVE’s graphics API, with Lua running in WASM. Includes a WebGL-free demo and browser tests.

projects.name: OMP Pet
projects.description: A native macOS desktop companion for oh-my-pi, built with Rust and AppKit. Session events travel over a private Unix socket to an animated pet and status readout.

projects.name: Dream-State Learning
projects.description: Experiments in continual agent memory: consolidating experience into adapter weights and measuring transfer with controlled environments and baseline comparisons.

projects.name: Geoshader
projects.description: A neural event-study pipeline exploring geopolitical shocks and defense-equity returns, with GDELT events, market data, and model interpretation.

projects.name: Greenhouse
projects.description: A portable macOS development setup with workstation tools, language runtimes, diagnostics, and reusable agent configuration.
